name: Hunt for Yenniku
summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Nimboya searches for Yenniku, the youngest son of his chieftain. He suspects the Bloodscalp tribe holds the boy and asks you to prove your strength by hunting their warriors and bringing back their tusks.

sections.title: A Chieftain's Lost Son
sections.body: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Nimboya fears a grim fate for Yenniku, the youngest son of the Darkspear chieftain. An old tribal custom placed the boy among the Gurubashi trolls of Zul'Gurub. When the Darkspear tribe left their homeland with the orc warchief Thrall, Yenniku was left behind and lost. Nimboya has returned from Orgrimmar to Stranglethorn Vale to find the chieftain's son and bring him to safety.

sections.title: Hunting the Bloodscalps
sections.body: Nimboya suspects the Bloodscalp tribe holds Yenniku. To prove you are strong enough to hunt them, he sends you north to gather nine tusks from Bloodscalp trolls. Bring the trophies back to Grom'gol Base Camp as proof of your strength in battle. Then the search for the chieftain's boy can continue with Headhunting.

faq.answer: Yenniku is the youngest son of the Darkspear chieftain. Tribal custom placed him among the Gurubashi trolls in Zul'Gurub, and he became separated from his people when they left the region.

faq.q: Why was Yenniku left behind in Stranglethorn?
faq.answer: Tribal custom sent Yenniku to the Gurubashi trolls of Zul'Gurub. When the Darkspear tribe left with Thrall, the boy was lost to them.
Nimboya is a Darkspear troll at Grom'gol Base Camp. He returned from Orgrimmar to Stranglethorn Vale to search for his chieftain's lost son.

faq.q: Why do you need to collect Bloodscalp tusks?
faq.answer: Nimboya suspects the Bloodscalp tribe holds Yenniku. He asks you to bring back nine Bloodscalp tusks as proof that you are strong enough to hunt these hostile trolls.

faq.q: Where are the Bloodscalp trolls located?
faq.answer: Nimboya sends hunters north from Grom'gol Base Camp into Bloodscalp territory.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you can answer Nimboya's call by aiding your chieftain's family and hunting the Bloodscalps who may hold Yenniku.
As a Horde ally at Grom'gol Base Camp, you can help Nimboya protect the Darkspear chieftain's kin. He came from Orgrimmar to search for the boy.

attribution: In-game quest text: Hunt for Yenniku
